name: Flashcards
description: Decks you can share, with a schedule that stays yours. Cards live in the space, so a study group builds one deck together and everybody drills the same material — but what you have learned is counted per person, so your intervals never move because a classmate answered well. Reviewing uses SM-2, the spaced-repetition schedule Anki is built on: rate a card and it comes back tomorrow, in six days, or in a month, depending on how well you have been doing with it. Each answer shows what it will cost you, so choosing is a decision rather than a guess. Editors write the cards; every member of the space, viewers included, studies and keeps their own schedule. Decks, cards and each person's progress are the space's own tables (flashcards_decks, flashcards, flashcards_reviews), synced with the space; the frame shows each person only their own progress, though any member opening the reviews table can read it.
